changelog:
🚀 1.3.7：429 短冷却与额度冷却分离；选号优先新鲜 token 且不再硬跳过临期号；热路径去掉 ProfileArn 阻塞解析并缓存空结果；后台改为高频刷 token + 分批补 usage/profile；流式提前 message_start/role 与更激进文本冲刷降低 TTFT；上游 429 快速换号。
🚀 1.3.7: Split short 429 cooldowns from quota cooldowns; prefer fresh tokens without hard-skipping near-expiry; remove hot-path ProfileArn resolution and cache empty lookups; background refresh does frequent token passes + batched usage/profile backfill; stream early message_start/role and aggressive text flush for lower TTFT; fail fast on upstream 429.
🚀 1.3.6: Merge upstream 1.1.5 improvements: stream integrity detection, stream empty/truncated retry, stop reasons/tool calls fixes, Vietnamese i18n, auth/profile region separation, web_search MCP, API key credentials import, Microsoft Enterprise SSO, request logs viewer improvements.
🚀 1.3.5：账号调度在现有规则上优先选择剩余额度更多的账号。
🚀 1.3.5: Account selection prefers higher remaining quota under existing routing rules.
🚀 1.3.4：新账号首次使用间隔可配置（管理面板，默认 60 秒，范围 1–3600，保存即时生效）。
🚀 1.3.4: Configurable new-account first-use interval (admin UI, default 60s, range 1–3600, live apply).
🚀 1.3.3：优化请求日志加载：服务端分页、错误预览截断、启动仅预热 500 条，前端按页渲染。
🚀 1.3.3: Faster request logs: server-side pagination, truncated error previews, warm only 500 rows at boot, paginated UI.
🚀 1.3.2：前端可配置生成请求并发上限 maxInFlightRequests（1–20000，保存即时生效）。
🚀 1.3.2: Admin UI setting for generation concurrency limit maxInFlightRequests (1–20000, live apply).
🚀 1.3.1：新增「重置全部统计」：可清空累计/今日/历史与账号运行时用量（保留账号本身）。
🚀 1.3.1: Add "Reset All Stats": clear lifetime/today/history and account runtime usage (accounts kept).
🚀 1.3.0：SQLite 主存储（legacy config.json 自动迁移）、大规模账号并发优化（dirty 刷盘/账号堆拷贝/后台刷新 worker 池）、每日统计归档、请求日志持久化（默认 10000 条，重启可恢复）、403 挂起自动封禁修复、模型日期快照映射、错误日志带本地账号邮箱。
🚀 1.3.0: SQLite primary store (auto-migrate legacy config.json), large-account concurrency (dirty flush / heap account copies / refresh worker pool), daily stats archive, persistent request logs (default 10000, survive restart), suspension auto-ban fix, dated model snapshot mapping, error logs with local account email.
